# Complete parts list

Everything needed to build one exxeta-arm. Search keywords and alternatives for each item are in the [BOM](bom.md). Nothing here has been bought or tested yet.

## 1. 3D printing

| Qty | Item | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 kg | PETG filament, 1.75 mm, main colour (light) | about 420 g used for base shell, turntable, links, wrist, gripper body, tolerance test, test-rig stand |
| 0.5 kg | PETG filament, 1.75 mm, accent colour (dark) | about 190 g used for bottom panel, bracket, clamp ring, wrist cap, fingers, pinion, pins, covers, test-rig arm |
| small amount | TPU filament (95A), 1.75 mm | two fingertip pads, about 5 g. Alternative: print them in PETG and add rubber tape |
| | Printer or print service | bed at least 170 × 170 mm (design limit 220 × 220 × 250), 0.4 mm nozzle |

PLA+ can replace PETG. One 1 kg spool is enough if a single colour is acceptable.

## 2. Servos and horns

| Qty | Item |
|---|---|
| 3 + 1 spare | MG996R servo, 180° (not "360° continuous") |
| 3 + 2 spare | MG90S servo, 180° |
| 3 + 1 spare | Metal round servo horn, 25T, about 20 mm, M3 threaded holes |
| 3–4 | Servo extension lead, 30 cm |

## 3. Bearings and balls

| Qty | Item |
|---|---|
| 3 + 1 spare | 608ZZ ball bearing (8 × 22 × 7 mm) |
| 50 | Steel ball, 6 mm (46 used) |

## 4. Fasteners

| Qty | Item |
|---|---|
| 14 | M3 × 8 screw |
| 16 | M3 × 10 screw |
| 16 | M3 × 12 screw |
| 3 | M3 × 16 screw |
| 40 | M3 hex nut |
| 2 | M2 × 10 self-tapping screw |
| 20 | Small zip tie, 2.5 mm |

An M3 assortment box (6–20 mm screws plus nuts) covers all of the M3 items.

## 5. Battery and power

| Qty | Item |
|---|---|
| 4 | 18650 Li-ion cell, genuine high-drain, 2500–3000 mAh, same model and batch |
| 2 | 18650 holder, 2 cells each |
| 1 | 2S BMS with balancing, 20 A |
| 1 | Inline blade fuse holder (16 AWG leads) + 15 A blade fuse (plus spares) |
| 1 | Rocker switch KCD3, 15 A or more |
| 1 | Servo buck converter: input from 6 V or lower, output 6.0 V, 8 A continuous or more (12 A 4.5–30 V module, or an RC UBEC of 10 A or more) |
| 1 | Logic buck converter, adjustable, 1 A or more (MP1584 or Mini360) |
| 1 | CC/CV charger module, adjustable voltage and current, 2 A or more (XL4015 CC/CV) |
| 1 | DC panel jack, 5.5 × 2.1 mm |
| 1 | DC adapter 12 V, 2 A or more, 5.5 × 2.1 mm plug, EU mains plug |
| 2 m each | Silicone wire 16 AWG, red and black |
| optional | USB-C 2S boost charger module (charging from a power bank) |

## 6. Control electronics

| Qty | Item |
|---|---|
| 1 | ESP32 DevKit, 38 pin (ESP32-WROOM-32) |
| 1 | Screw-terminal expansion board for the 38-pin DevKit |
| 1 | USB cable for the ESP32 (data, not charge-only) |
| 1 | USB-C panel-mount extension matching the DevKit's USB port |
| 1 | WS2812B or SK6812 RGB LED on a small board |
| 1 | Electrolytic capacitor 1000–2200 µF, 10 V or more, low ESR |
| 1 | Schottky diode 1N5819 |
| 1 each | Resistors 100 kΩ, 33 kΩ, 330 Ω; capacitor 100 nF |
| a few | Thin hook-up wire, 3-pin header strip, heat-shrink tube |
| optional, 4 | Rotary pot B10K, 6 mm D-shaft, 15 mm shaft (WH148 type) |

## 7. Tools and consumables

Multimeter, soldering iron and solder, small Phillips and hex screwdrivers, side cutters, calipers, kitchen scales (to check cells), grease, double-sided foam tape, and a PC for the control software.
